name: AgaMatrix
old_description: Engineered accuracy to support medication management, GLP-1 therapy, and CGM confirmation.
about:
AgaMatrix is based in Derry, New Hampshire. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed on its website. The business presents itself as a provider of diabetes care technology, focusing on engineered accuracy for medication management, GLP-1 therapy, and continuous glucose monitor (CGM) confirmation.

The company offers a range of diabetes testing supplies sold directly through its website. Its product line includes glucose meters such as the Presto and the Bluetooth-enabled Jazz Wireless 2, along with test strips, control solutions, and lancing devices with lancets. The Jazz Wireless 2 meter connects to the AgaMatrix Diabetes Manager mobile application for data tracking. No details about manufacturing processes, facility size, headcount, or production volumes are provided.

AgaMatrix serves the diabetes care market, targeting both individual consumers and potentially healthcare providers. The website operates as a retail storefront with listed prices and a shopping cart, indicating direct-to-consumer sales. No specific business-to-business customers, original equipment manufacturer (OEM) relationships, or industry verticals beyond diabetes management are mentioned.

The company emphasizes "engineered accuracy" and "trusted results & value price" as its core value proposition. It positions its products as simple, accurate tools designed for everyday confidence in diabetes management, with wireless connectivity for modern data integration.
